answer_1.quote: We evaluate the effectiveness, helpfulness, and efficiency of the proposed method... For utility, we consider two datasets: GSM8K and Just-Eval. GSM8K is designed to test the model's ability to solve complex mathematical problems.

answer_2.quote: We use standard ROUGE-1 score for the accuracy on GSM8K... we report the average Attack Success Rate (ASR) and the average harmful score... we report the False Refusal Rate (FRR)... we use the Average Token Generation Time Ratio (ATGR) metric.

answer_3.quote: For safety evaluation, we adopt the evaluation pipeline from ..., utilizing Qwen-max as a judge to automatically assess the safety of the generated outputs. The judge LLM assigns scores to the responses based on both the questions and the content of the answers, with scores ranging from 1 to 5.
methods: LLM judge scoring based on prompts
